name: Slow requests (> 1s)
select: Timestamp,ServiceName,SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] AS method,SpanAttributes['http.route'] AS route,SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] AS status,round(Duration/1e6) AS duration_ms
where: SpanKind = 'Server' AND Duration > 1000000000 AND ServiceName NOT LIKE 'hdx-oss-%'
